svg.font-family: Noto Sans, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: NVR demo data flow and hardware
svg.desc: ReID consumes original VA frame ROIs on the GPU. Search thumbnails use a separate CPU readback. MobileCLIP NPU input is shared in process.
svg.text: NVR demo data flow and hardware
Embedding example: MobileCLIP2-S2 on NPU. VA-frame nodes reuse the same decoded source; processing is independently scheduled.
Hidden cameras: continuous decode with ReID; otherwise optional keyframe sampling. Recording continues independently.
Green includes output-buffer writes and GPU-to-GPU copies.
MobileCLIP input audit ends at the EP boundary; EP-internal copies/conversions are excluded.
